definitions.paired: treatment minus control, restricted to seeds 1-120; swapped seats averaged within seed
definitions.pct: percentage; pct SE values are percentage points
definitions.pooled: ratio of summed numerator to summed denominator; null for denominator zero
definitions.sample_se: sample SD / sqrt(n); null for n < 2
